system.description:
This extremely powerful ritual grants the caster an almost complete identification with his attuned domain: he instantly knows if something threatens the land or its creatures, senses hostile forces within it, predicts weather that will affect it, and can exercise subtle control over its features — moving trees to obscure a path, redirecting or widening a stream, or raising boulders to block a mountain pass.

System: The caster buries himself in a grave near the center of his domain for a full day; upon rising he drinks an infusion of his blood mixed with the soil in which he lay, uniting his essence with the land's. Spending eight Blood Traits per week maintains the connection indefinitely; if a week passes without this expenditure, the bond breaks and the ritual must be repeated.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book Two: Usurpers (Tremere)
system.bloodCost: 8 Blood Traits per week to maintain
system.prerequisites: Sielanic Path of the World's Blood
